datasets.name: Planet Satellite images
datasets.verbatim: This study uses the high-resolution (3 m) Planet Satellite images obtained five days after the earthquake [54]... Available online: https://api.planet.com (accessed on 10 January 2019).

datasets.name: Iburi earthquake's landslide inventory map
datasets.verbatim: The Iburi earthquake's landslide inventory map (Figure 3B) was prepared by our visual interpretation to the Planet Satellite images.

datasets.name: Topographic background
datasets.verbatim: The topographic background is from National Geophysical Data Center, NOAA [53]... Available online: https://www.ngdc.noaa.gov/mgg/global/relief/ETOPO1/docs/ETOPO1.pdf (accessed on 10 January 2019).

methods.name: ENVINet5
methods.summary: A U-Net based encoder-decoder architecture with 5 levels and 23 convolutional layers, implemented within the ENVI Deep Learning Module, used for pixel-based classification of remote sensing images to identify landslides.
methods.verbatim: The ENVINet5 architecture used by the ENVI Deep Learning Module is based on the U-Net architecture developed by Ronneberger et al. [47].

reproducibility_assessment: The Planet satellite imagery and ETOPO1 topographic data are publicly accessible, but the landslide inventory used for training is not linked or provided. The ENVINet5 method is implemented via a commercial software module without a provided repository or code link.
